# czc-v2026.10.22.3 (0.2.17.20)

DeepSeek Responses requests no longer fail with
`400 unsupported_tool: unsupported Responses tool type "web_search" ... on Chat route`
when a client (Codex, OpenCode, OpenDesign, ...) includes OpenAI hosted tools.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.22.2

### DeepSeek

- **Strip hosted Responses tools before forwarding.** DeepSeek routes some
  models (for example `deepseek-v4.1-flash`) from `/responses` to its internal
  Chat route, which only accepts client tools. sub2api now drops hosted tool
  types such as `web_search` and `image_generation` from `tools` before the
  request leaves the gateway. `function`, `custom`, `tool_search`,
  `namespace`, and `x_search` are kept unchanged.
- **`tool_choice` cleanup.** A `tool_choice` that targets a stripped hosted
  tool is removed. When every tool was stripped, both `tools` and
  `tool_choice` are removed so the request is sent as a plain text turn.
  `auto` / `none` / `required` choices are kept while client tools remain.
- **Scope.** Applies to `platform=deepseek` accounts using the native
  Responses protocol (`responses` or `adaptive`), and to `openai` platform
  API-key accounts whose `base_url` points at `api.deepseek.com`. OpenAI,
  Kimi, and all other upstreams are untouched.

## VERSION

`0.2.17.20`

## Upgrade guidance

Drop-in, no database migration and no configuration change. Clients do not
need to disable web search any more when routed to DeepSeek; the model simply
does not receive the hosted search tool.

## Compatibility

- DeepSeek has no hosted web search on this route, so no capability is lost:
  those requests previously failed outright.
- Request bodies with no hosted tools are forwarded byte-for-byte as before.

## Rollback

Redeploy `czc-v2026.10.22.2`, or restore the backup
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.22.3-<UTC timestamp>` created during
this deploy and restart `sub2api.service`.
